scope: Android 15 ARM64 standalone filesystem broker over SOCK_SEQPACKET
checks: A writable regular FD shared its smaller and larger size across three hard-linked names and an independent broker session.
Truncation preserved the current OFD offset. Growth produced zero bytes in the new range; a zero-length write after truncating to zero did not extend the file.
A forked broker session retained the same OFD offset and exposed the new zero byte in its parent session.
Negative length returned EINVAL; an invalid FD returned EBADF; read-only and directory FDs were rejected.
The 256 MiB limit was accepted with a zero final byte and fewer allocated blocks than logical size; 256 MiB plus one and INT64_MAX returned EFBIG with original content size preserved.
skipped: Pre-existing FIFO fixture: device denied mkfifo with errno 13; FIFO handling not exercised.
